The '''Coreesh Mountains''' was a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] range that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Veroleem]], several dozen [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] to the east of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[New Promise]]. The mountain range contained the ruins of an ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]], which was discovered by the [[Force Adept]] [[Kryo Tinwole]] after Veroleem was colonized. Tinwole later formed the [[Cult of Veroleem]] and the cult established a [[temple]] in the Coreesh Mountains.<ref name="TUR" />
